items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Blanton changed the bass. Jimmy Blanton changed the whole concept of the bass.

ctx.x: In the whole evolution of bass playing, who do you see as the important, you know, players who really, you know, changed the bass and opened it up?

Jimmy Blanton changed the bass. Jimmy Blanton changed the whole concept of the bass. But I think the greatest bass player that I know is Ray Brown. He is complete in all aspects. I'm not putting down anybody else, but Ray Brown is --
